name: Wolf Creek
description: Rises near Loma Rica, runs through downtown Grass Valley and the North Star / Wolf Creek Trail corridor, then south ~30 km to the Bear River near Wolf.

sites.name: Loma Rica Trail bridge
sites.access: Public trail (Loma Rica Trail); upper Wolf Creek near the headwaters.

sites.name: Downtown Grass Valley (Elisabeth Daniels Park)
sites.access: City pocket park off Bank St by the Park & Ride. Wolf Creek is in a culvert under downtown (OSM way 1085194147) and reappears here at its outlet.

sites.name: Wolf Creek Trail at Glen Jones Park / North Star Museum
sites.access: Public trail and picnic area at the North Star Mining Museum (Allison Ranch Rd).

sites.name: Daspah Seyo Trail
sites.access: Public trail continuing downstream of the museum along Wolf Creek.

sites.name: Allison Ranch Road bridge (La Barr Meadows)
sites.access: View from the public road bridge only; land on both banks is private. USGS sampled water quality here (site 390955121034101).

sites.name: Wolf Road bridge (near Wolf)
sites.access: View from the public road bridge only. Former USGS site 11423150 'Wolf C nr Wolf CA', ~3 km above the Bear River.

name: Deer Creek
description: Flows from Scotts Flat Reservoir through downtown Nevada City, along the Deer Creek Tribute Trail, past Rough and Ready to Lake Wildwood, then on to the Yuba River near Smartsville.

sites.name: Pioneer Park (Little Deer Creek)
sites.access: City park. NOTE: this is Little Deer Creek, a tributary that joins Deer Creek ~0.6 km downstream at Calanan Park.

sites.name: Downtown Nevada City (Calanan Park / Miner's Trail)
sites.access: City park and footpath at Broad St / Hwy 49, just below the Little Deer Creek confluence.

sites.name: Deer Creek Tribute Trail, Angkula Seo Bridge
sites.access: Public trail suspension bridge on the Tribute Trail (Providence Mine Rd trailhead).

sites.name: Deer Creek Tribute Trail, lower bridge (Champion Mine Rd)
sites.access: Public trail bridge near Stocking Flat (Champion Mine Rd trailhead).

sites.name: Bitney Springs Road bridge
sites.access: View from the public road bridge only, between Nevada City and Rough and Ready.

sites.name: Pleasant Valley Road bridge (below Lake Wildwood)
sites.access: View from the public road bridge only, Penn Valley; below the Lake Wildwood dam.
